name: user-gate
description: Tool-call approvals: ask before a tool call runs (opt-in; convenience triage, not enforcement)

enabled.description: OFF by default: with default "ask" a default-on gate would prompt on every tool call. Set true to turn approvals on.

default.description: What an unmatched tool call does. "ask" prompts (interactive); "allow" runs (the lockdown style is "allow" plus a deny list); "deny" blocks without prompting -- allowlist-only, and the only shape usable headless (one-shot/CI): a call the allow list forgot fails with the exact line to add in its own block text. Under "deny" an unrecognized tool and a command the bash analyzer bailed on both deny too -- unverifiable is not allowed.

tools.description: Extra tool patterns and which of their params are approval targets, e.g. { "mcp__db__query": ["statement"] }. Naming a tool here also marks it recognized (so it follows "default" instead of always asking).

allow.description: Rules that silence the ask. Grammar: 'tool' or 'tool.param=glob' -- bash.cmd=git, edit.paths=src, fetch.url=https://example.com/*. Paths use the workspace.deny dialect, matched against the absolute AND the root-relative path.

deny.description: Rules that block without prompting and cannot be overridden mid-run. Same grammar; deny beats allow.
